whySuitable: Publishes reporting and stories from rural India, including farming and food; a 'Write for us' page exists.
evidence: Web search on 2026-10-20 returned the 'Write for Us' page. The page itself was not opened from the build environment.
suggestedContribution: An original, reported story from the farm or producer Desi Nature works with, with the owner's own photographs. Not a promotional piece.
notes: Owner: open the guidelines, confirm they accept contributions on this kind of topic, and whether they link to contributors.

whySuitable: Agriculture magazine and website published in several Indian languages, covering farming practice and agri-business.
evidence: Web search summary of the site's contact page lists a content email. No contributor guidelines were found; the site appears to be mainly staff-written.
suggestedContribution: Offer a factual, sourced explainer (for example on household grain storage) or farm photographs for an existing story, only after confirming they accept outside contributions.
notes: Owner: open the contact page and copy the content address from it before any outreach. Do not pitch advertorials as editorial.

whySuitable: Covers Indian agriculture, food and small enterprises; has run reader photo-story and story submission pages.
evidence: Web search found a photo-story submission page and a student journalist programme; it is unclear which submission route is current.
suggestedContribution: Only if there is a genuine story (a farmer, a method, a place) with the subject's consent and the owner's photographs.

whySuitable: Original, well-captioned photographs of Indian farm foods, crops and storage released under a free licence can be reused by publishers and Wikipedia with attribution.
evidence: General knowledge of how Commons works; attribution links are not guaranteed and must not be the reason to upload.
suggestedContribution: Upload a small set of the owner's own documentary photographs (crops, grain storage, ghee preparation) with accurate captions. Never add links to Wikipedia articles for promotion.

whySuitable: The legitimate listing for a business with a real address or service area; helps people find and verify the business.
evidence: Requires a real business address or service area and verification by Google.
suggestedContribution: Create and verify the profile with accurate details only: name, category, service area, hours, website, real photographs.
notes: Owner action. Do not create a listing at an address the business does not operate from.

organization: Local Krishi Vigyan Kendra or state agricultural university extension office
whySuitable: Extension services work directly with farmers and producers; a genuine relationship (training, field day, farmer network) can lead to being listed or referenced.
evidence: Relationship-based; depends on where the owner and suppliers are located.
suggestedContribution: Attend a field day or training with a supplier; share accurate field notes or photographs if invited. Never ask for a link as a condition.
notes: Owner to name the district so the right KVK can be identified.

whySuitable: Real suppliers with their own websites or social pages can link to where their produce is sold, and Desi Nature can link back to them.
evidence: Depends on suppliers the owner actually works with. Placeholder until the owner lists them.
suggestedContribution: A supplier profile page on desinature.in written with the supplier's consent; they may choose to link to it. Avoid systematic reciprocal link swaps.

whySuitable: Reporters request expert comment; a genuine, specific answer about Indian food storage or farm sourcing can earn a mention.
evidence: Platform terms, costs and India coverage not checked. Free tiers may be limited.
suggestedContribution: Answer only requests where the owner has real first-hand knowledge. Never answer as a fabricated expert.
notes: Owner to check terms and whether a free plan exists before signing up.
